mapper.sql: select delivery_order_id, delivery_order_no, sales_order_id, sales_order_no, customer_id, customer_name, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, delivery_date, total_qty, delivery_status, logistics_company, tracking_no, outbound_order_id, outbound_order_no, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from erp_delivery_order
mapper.select:
and delivery_order_no like concat('%', #{deliveryOrderNo}, '%') and sales_order_no like concat('%', #{salesOrderNo}, '%') and customer_name like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%') and delivery_status = #{deliveryStatus}
order by delivery_date desc, delivery_order_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into erp_delivery_order(delivery_order_no, sales_order_id, sales_order_no, customer_id, customer_name, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, delivery_date, total_qty, delivery_status, logistics_company, tracking_no, outbound_order_id, outbound_order_no, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{deliveryOrderNo}, #{salesOrderId}, #{salesOrderNo}, #{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{warehouseId}, #{warehouseName}, #{deliveryDate}, #{totalQty}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{logisticsCompany}, #{trackingNo}, #{outboundOrderId}, #{outboundOrderNo}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update erp_delivery_order set sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId}, sales_order_no = #{salesOrderNo}, customer_id = #{customerId}, customer_name = #{customerName}, warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, warehouse_name = #{warehouseName}, delivery_date = #{deliveryDate}, total_qty = #{totalQty}, delivery_status = #{deliveryStatus}, logistics_company = #{logisticsCompany}, tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, outbound_order_id = #{outboundOrderId}, outbound_order_no = #{outboundOrderNo}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where delivery_order_id = #{deliveryOrderId} and delivery_status = '草稿'

update erp_delivery_order set delivery_status = #{deliveryStatus}, outbound_order_id = #{outboundOrderId}, outbound_order_no = #{outboundOrderNo}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where delivery_order_id = #{deliveryOrderId}
mapper.delete: delete from erp_delivery_order where delivery_order_id in #{deliveryOrderId}
